long_biography.plain_text:
Robert Scott Butwin combines ownership of ETC Companies with the trade credentials of a certified general contractor. The firm names him among three co-owners who support project teams and coordinate with clients, while his Florida licence has qualified the construction business since 2006.

His practical background also produced a patented folding layout tool for setting accurate right angles on building sites. Butwin designed the connected 3-4-5 triangle to replace a two-tape method that normally required two people. At ETC, that construction experience now supports affordable-housing work ranging from new developments to rehabilitation in occupied residential complexes.
